hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. When the micro-contract share of opening volume is high, the 09:30-09:35 thrust is driven by retail/prop evaluation flow (no information) and partly reverts by 10:00 (own idea, candidates.md rank 83, IG C-12-21). Sign fixed: FADE the first five minutes, only in high-micro-share sessions.
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, stype_in=continuous, <ROOT>.v.0, bought 2026-11-09 by batch job AFTER this registration (estimate row first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet, ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/. Times are America/New_York via zoneinfo. P(HH:MM) = CLOSE of the bar opening HH:MM-1min (last trade before HH:MM:00); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within 5 minutes with the same instrument_id, else the observation is ineligible (counted). Any return uses two prices with the same instrument_id (roll rule ex ante). Trading days = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars), early closes skipped. EWMA sigma = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of the squared signal over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations (IS warm-up read first). r5(d) = ln(P(09:35)/OPEN of the bar opening 09:30 ET) on ES. Micro share s(d) = (MES volume of the 09:30-09:34 bars / 10) / (ES volume of the same bars + MES volume / 10). Gate: s(d) >= the 67th percentile of s over the prior 60 eligible days (>= 40). Trade iff gate and |r5| >= 1.0 x EWMA sigma of r5. Position = -sign(r5), one ES contract. ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 09:35 ET; EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 09:59 ET. Per-event net bp.
parameters: thrust window 09:30-09:35; threshold 1.0 sigma; micro-share gate top tercile of trailing 60 days; exit 09:59 close (25 min); neighbours (fixed now): threshold 0.75 and 1.25 sigma; exit at the CLOSE of the 09:53 bar and of the 10:05 bar (hold 19 / 31 min); gate 60th and 75th percentile; one-bar-delay = entry at the OPEN of the 09:36 bar; volatility terciles as Q-0017. Information only: control arm (same fade in bottom-tercile sessions); 08:30-release days vs others.
instruments: CME ES (MES for sizing and for the share)
vol_scaler: none: one ES contract per event
cost_model: per side ES 0.30 pt x $50 + $2.50 (RTH), entry and exit; 2x run doubles.
notes: post-change: institutional change date 2019-05-06 (MES launch; micro share undefined before) and the 2020-2021 retail surge; OOS 2022-2024 is the post-change window. MES starts 2019-05-06, so OOS is 3.0 years: criterion-4 power ~0.05 at true Sharpe 1.5 - LOW POWER (D-020). Closed relatives adjacent: H0012/H0017 (09:31 S&P gap fade, closed) and H0020 (5-min ORB, opposite trade); the new element is the micro-share gate. Honest prior ~0.03.
owner: Director (main session 2026-11-09, D-028); Pre-registration Officer: Director
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): sha256 of each derived parquet written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read; the result file prints manifest = recomputed
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (IS read for warm-up first): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West lag 10 and the ET-date-clustered t of the net-1x per-event series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) PARAMETERS.md criteria 4 and 7: >= 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, >= 2 of 3 IS-bounded volatility terciles positive, every +-25% neighbour in parameters net-positive, the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team / re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Mechanical verdict: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3); NEAR-MISS if deciding t >= 2.6807 with bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL. Before the OOS read, on IS only: truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; decision unchanged), perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
